y-m-51-01.title: Ukuba amaxabiso asekupheleni kwesithuba ayahluka, ingaba umsebenzi ophambeneyo uyakhona?
y-m-51-01.topic: Umsebenzi we-quadratic onedomeyini ekhawulelweyo nobukho bomsebenzi ophambeneyo
y-m-51-01.goal: Bonisa ngomzekelo ochasayo ukuba kutheni umgaqo othi 'ukuba amaxabiso omsebenzi asekupheleni zombini kwesithuba ayahluka, ukungqamana okunye-nenye' awonelanga, uze wakhe izithuba ezininzi apho umsebenzi ophambeneyo ukhona.
y-m-51-01.material: Vumela idomeyini yomsebenzi f(x)=x²-4x+3 ibe sisithuba a≤x≤b (a<b), kwaye i-codomain ibe onke amaxabiso athathwa ngu-f kwisithuba esi (uluhlu). Ukuze umsebenzi ophambeneyo wo-f ukhona, f kufuneka ibe kungqamana okunye-nenye kwesi sithuba. USua wathi, "Ukuba amaxabiso omsebenzi asekupheleni zombini kwesithuba ahlukile (f(a)≠f(b)), ngoko f ikungqamana okunye-nenye kuso eso sithuba." (Uphawu: f(x) ifundwa 'f of x', kwaye x² ifundwa 'x squared'.)

y-m-51-07.title: Ingaba iindawo zokunqumla nomsebenzi ophikisayo rhoqo zikwi-y=x?
y-m-51-07.topic: Iindawo zokunqumla zegrafu yomsebenzi negrafu yomsebenzi wayo ophikisayo
y-m-51-07.goal: Ungaqinisekiswa libango elithi 'iindawo zokunqumla ze-f ne-f⁻¹ rhoqo zikwi-y=x' bubungqina bomsebenzi omnye; yenza umzekelo ochasayo ngomsebenzi ohlayo, uze ucacisele umhlobo ukuba wahlukile njani komsebenzi onyukayo.
y-m-51-07.material: UMinjae uthe, "Amachaphaza apho y=f(x) nomsebenzi wayo ophikisayo y=f⁻¹(x) adibana khona rhoqo akumgca y=x. Kuba iigrafu ezimbini ziyahambelana ngokuthi y=x." Njengobungqina, usombulule f(x)=x³ (isizinda sonke amanani okwenene) wabonisa ukuba iindawo zokunqumla (-1,-1), (0,0), (1,1) zonke zikwi-y=x. (f⁻¹ ifundwa 'f ephikisayo'.)

y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.b: Amachaphaza amaninzi aphuma kumsebenzi ofanayo luhlolo lomsebenzi omnye. Ukuba ifanayo kwezinye imisebenzi kububanzi obahlukileyo.

y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.c: Hlola ukuba akukho meko apho iigrafu ezimbini ezihambelanayo zidibana ngaphandle kwe-y=x. Nokuba ziyahambelana, amachaphaza amabini abhekene anokuba zizindawo zokunqumla zombini.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.o.d: Umsebenzi wekyubhiki awunamsebenzi ophikisayo, ngoko olu bungqina alunakusetyenziswa kwasekuqaleni
y-m-51-07.s.s1.r.d: f(x)=x³ luhambelwano olunye-nye kuwo onke amanani okwenene, ngoko unomsebenzi ophikisayo. Ukuba ubungqina bunokusetyenziswa na nokuba buyanela na zizinto ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-51-07.s.s1.explain: f(x)=x³ ngumsebenzi onyukayo. Kwimisebenzi enyukayo iindawo zokunqumla zikwi-y=x, kodwa kwimisebenzi ehlayo zinokungabi njalo ngokuqinisekileyo. Ukuhlola umsebenzi omnye akuqinisekisi lonke ibango.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.prompt: Kwi-f(x)=-x³ (isizinda sonke amanani okwenene, uhambelwano olunye-nye), fumana amachaphaza (a, b) akwigrafu ye-f nakwigrafu ye-f⁻¹ kodwa angekho kwi-y=x. Yenza amachaphaza ama-2 ahlukeneyo.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala ngokwahlukeneyo intetho ye-(a, b) ekwi-f neyokuba ikwi-f⁻¹ (intetho ene-a no-b zitshintshisiwe).
y-m-51-07.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani aphelele amancinci njenge--1, 0, 1 kwi-a ukufumana b uze uhlole ukuba intetho yesibini iyabamba.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Ichaphaza (b,a) nalo likwi-f, ngoko (a,b) likwi-f⁻¹ nalo.
y-m-51-07.s.s2.explain: Ukuba (a,b) likwi-f, ngoko b=-a³, kwaye ukuba likwi-f⁻¹, ngoko (b,a) likwi-f, ngoko a=-b³. Ukusuka kwizintetho ezimbini, a⁹=a, ngoko a=0, 1, -1, kwaye awekho kwi-y=x kuphela amachaphaza amabini (1,-1) kunye (-1,1).
y-m-51-07.s.s3.prompt: Bhala impendulo yokuthumela kuMinjae. Bonisa ngokukhethekileyo umsebenzi apho ibango likaMinjae liphuka khona neendawo zawo zokunqumla, uze wongeze ukuba kuhlobo luni lomsebenzi apho ibango lichanekile.
y-m-51-07.s.s3.hint.0: Khetha elinye lamachaphaza owenzileyo kwinyathelo langaphambili uze utshintshele ngokuthe ngqo ukuhlola ukuba likwi-f na nokuba (b,a) likwi-f na.
y-m-51-07.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala impendulo ngolandelelwano 'umzekelo ochasayo → imeko apho ichanekile → isishwankathelo somgca omnye'.
y-m-51-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba uhlolile ngezintetho ezimbini ukuba ichaphaza olinikileyo likwi-f ngokwenene nakwi-f⁻¹?

y-m-51-07.s.s3.model.0: Kwi-f(x)=-x³, (1,-1) likwi-f, kwaye f(-1)=1, ngoko likwi-f⁻¹ nalo. Kodwa alilolo ichaphaza elikwi-y=x. Ibango lichanekile kwimisebenzi enyukayo, kodwa linokuphuka ukuba f iyahla.
y-m-51-07.s.s3.model.1: Ukuba ngumsebenzi onyukayo iindawo zokunqumla zikwi-y=x, kodwa umsebenzi ohlayo onjenge--x³ udibana nangaphandle kwe-y=x, njengakwi-(-1,1) nakwi-(1,-1). Kuba ziyahambelana, akufuneki ugqibe ngelithi zidibana kwi-y=x.
y-m-51-07.s.s3.modelNote.1: Le yimpendulo ekwakhankanye ukuba ibambe kwimisebenzi enyukayo.

y-m-51-02.title: Ukuba sitshintsha ulandelelwano lokudibanisa, ingaba iyafana?
y-m-51-02.goal: Yazi ukuba amaxabiso ambalwa e-x apho ukutshintshanisa ulandelelwano kwanika isiphumo esifanayo akunakubonisa ukuba imisebenzi emibini iyafana, uze wakhe ngokwakho izibini zemisebenzi yomgca apho ulandelelwano lungabalulekanga uze utsho umthetho.
y-m-51-02.material: Kukho imisebenzi emibini f(x)=2x+1 kunye g(x)=x². UMinsu wathi, "Imisebenzi edityaniswe iyafana nokuba utshintshanisa ulandelelwano. Ndiyizamile ngokwam. Ukuba x=0, f(g(0))=1 kwaye g(f(0))=1. Ukuba x=-2, f(g(-2))=9 kwaye g(f(-2))=9. Zombini ziyafana, ngoko f∘g=g∘f." (f∘g ifundwa 'f composed with g', kwaye g(x) ifundwa 'g of x'.)
y-m-51-02.thinking.0: Phonononga isibakala esenziwe isigqibo jikelele kwizifaniso ezimbalwa

y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.b: Zikho izibini zemisebenzi eziyahlala zinjalo xa ulandelelwano lutshintshaniswa. Ukwahluka kwesi sibini akuthethi ukuba zonke izibini zinjalo.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.c: Nokuba ziyafana kwi-x=0, -2, kufuneka ziyafane kuyo yonke i-x, ngoko kufuneka sibale amanye amaxabiso afana ne-x=1 nawo
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.c: Ujonge 'yonke i-x', hayi inani lamaxabiso ahambelanayo. Uyazi ukuba enye i-x inokuphula isibakala sokuba imisebenzi emibini iyafana.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.o.d: Ama-x avavanyiweyo ayeyi-0 nenani elibi kuphela, ngoko ingxaki kukuba iimpawu zazahlukile, yaye ukuba kuhlolwa ngenani elingqina kuba linye
y-m-51-02.s.s1.r.d: Asiyo ingxaki yeempawu. Ukuba ngawaphi ama-x enza ukulingana kumiselwa ngamabinzana ngokwawo. Bala ngokuthe ngqo kwi-x=1 engqina.
y-m-51-02.s.s1.explain: f(g(x))=2x²+1 kunye g(f(x))=(2x+1)²=4x²+4x+1, yaye amabinzana amabini alingana kuphela kwi-x=0, -2. Kwi-x=1 zi-3 nesi-9, ngoko ziyahluka. Nokuba zihambelana kuma-x ambalwa, ukuze zibe 'ngumsebenzi ofanayo' kufuneka zilingane kuyo yonke x.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.prompt: Vumela f(x)=ax+b (a≠0) kunye g(x)=x+c. Yenza (a, b, c) ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo ukuze f∘g=g∘f kuyo yonke x yaye f no-g ngemisebenzi eyahlukileyo.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.hint.0: Bhala f(g(x)) kunye g(f(x)) nganye ngefom ax+(isiqhubekayo), uze uthelekise iinxalenye eziqhubekayo.
y-m-51-02.s.s2.hint.1: Faka amanani aphelele amancinci ku-a no-c wenze itafile ukuhlola ukuba iinxalenye ezimbini eziqhubekayo ziyalingana na.

y-m-51-02.s.s2.explain: f(g(x))=a(x+c)+b=ax+ac+b kunye g(f(x))=ax+b+c. Ukuze amabinzana amabini alingane kuyo yonke x, sidinga ac+b=b+c, oko kukuthi, ac=c. Ngoko c=0 okanye a=1 iyasebenza (umzekelo a=3, b=2, c=0 okanye a=1, b=2, c=5). Zombini iindawo zimpendulo.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.prompt: Ujonga imizekelo osandula ukuyenza, bhala umthetho we-(a, b, c) ukuze f∘g=g∘f. Yongeza nokuba intetho kaMinsu ilunge kuphela nini.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale amabinzana amabini owafumana ngokuhlela f(g(x)) kunye g(f(x)).
y-m-51-02.s.s3.hint.1: Bhala amaxabiso ka-a no-c emizekelo yakho emithathu ecaleni kwenye uze ujonge oko banako ngokufanayo.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba lo mthetho ulunge kuyo yonke imizekelo emithathu owayenzileyo?
y-m-51-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ufumene zombini iindawo (imeko a=1 nemeko c=0), okanye ukuba ufumene enye kuphela, ingaba ucinge ukuba enye isenokukho?

y-m-51-02.s.s3.model.0: f∘g=ax+ac+b kunye g∘f=ax+b+c, ngoko zilingana kuphela xa ac=c. Ngoko a=1 okanye c=0 iyafuneka. Intetho kaMinsu ilunge kuphela kwezo meko.
y-m-51-02.s.s3.model.1: Ekubeni g yi-x+c, ukuba c=0 ngoko g(x)=x, ngoko ucwangciso alunamsebenzi nayiphi na f, yaye ukuba umthambeka we-f u-1, zombini ziintshukumo, ngoko ucwangciso alunamsebenzi. Intetho kaMinsu ilunge kuphela kwezi meko.

y-m-51-05.title: Hlola indlela yokusebenza efumene ubuncinane kwisithuba
y-m-51-05.topic: Ubuninzi nobuncinane bomsebenzi we-quadratic onesixeko esithintelweyo
y-m-51-05.goal: Fumana impazamo kwindlela yokusebenza yobuncinane bomsebenzi we-quadratic kwisithuba esithintelweyo eyaphoswa yimeko apho incopho ingaphandle kwesithuba, uze wakhe izithuba ezininzi apho ubuninzi nobuncinane bethatha amaxabiso anikiweyo.
y-m-51-05.material: Le yingxaki yokufumana ubuninzi nobuncinane bomsebenzi f(x)=x²-4x+1 xa isixeko si-3≤x≤6. Indlela yokusebenza kaJunho injalo. (x² ifundwa ngokuthi 'x isikwere', kwaye ≤ ifundwa ngokuthi 'incinci okanye ilingana'.)

Umgca wesi-4 sisigqibo esithwala loo mpazamo. Ukubala kwimigca yoku-1 nowesi-3 kulunge. Kwesi sithuba igrafu inyuka ngasekunene, ngoko ubuncinane bu-f(3)=-2 kwi-x=3.
y-m-51-05.s.s2.prompt: Ujonga umsebenzi ofanayo f(x)=x²-4x+1 kwisithuba a≤x≤b (a<b), yenza izithuba ezi-3 ezahlukeneyo apho ubuncinane bu-−3 kwaye ubuninzi bu-6.
